speaker: Doctor
text: Since the CT scan is normal and you have no fever or blood in your stool, your symptoms are likely due to antibiotic-associated diarrhea rather than severe pseudomembranous colitis. speaker: Doctor
text: With your normal CT scan, electrolytes, and lack of fever, your condition appears to be mild antibiotic-associated diarrhea rather than severe C. difficile colitis.
